note: Council of Ministers communique orders a modernisation plan and local annexes for the ONS; it names no statistics law or draft.

facts.fact: An ONS presentation of 1 July 2025 states that Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 remains the legal basis of official statistics in Algeria and makes the ONS the central authority, and that the law is under review for Big Data and digital change.
facts.system: Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system

note: Passages hold only the Journal Officiel contents list naming Presidential Decree 25-293 of 10 November 2025 placing the ONS under the Prime Minister; no text tying it to a statistics law.

facts.fact: Executive Decree 95-159 cites Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system as the law under which the ONS is the central statistics institution.
facts.system: Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system

facts.fact: Executive Decree 95-159 of 3 June 1995 restates the statutes of the ONS, made under Articles 11 and 17 of Legislative Decree 94-01.
facts.system: Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system

note: SPI 5.1.1 legislation score names no law or year; no fact.

facts.fact: Le Courrier d'Algerie reports, citing the ONS site, that the national statistical information system was reorganised by the legislative decree of 15 January 1994, which sets the principles, organisation and rights and duties for producing and using statistics.

note: No rules or act under the law are tied to it; the tutelle decrees are not stated to be made under it.

facts.fact: El Mouid reports the Prime Minister's written reply saying the legal texts governing the national statistical system, not updated since 1994, are under review by a National Statistics Council working committee.
facts.system: legal texts of the national statistical system (1994)
